cards.title: Men and women in admissions

headline.caption: of colleges admit women at a notably higher rate than men

cards.sentence: In fall 2004, 13% of colleges admitted men at a rate 3 or more points higher than women; in fall 2024, 6% did, while 48% favored women by as much.

cards.title: The Pell graduation gap

headline.caption: point gap between Pell recipients and students with neither, at the median college

cards.sentence: At the median college, Pell recipients from the class entering fall 2010 graduated within six years 9 points less often than students with neither a Pell Grant nor a subsidized loan; for the class entering fall 2018 the gap was 11 points.
